title: "Aakriti's Animint Gallery"
output: html_document

## My Interactive Visualizations Portfolio

```{r echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
user <- "aakritixyz"
repos <- c(
  "ten-points-animint", "iris-animint-test", "worldbank-animint-test", 
  "kmeans-animint-test", "mc-sample-mean-test", "buffon-needle-test", 
  "rosling-bubbles-test"
)

cat("<table>\n<thead>\n<tr><th>Screenshot</th><th>Project Title</th><th>Links</th></tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n")

for(repo in repos){
  img_url  <- paste0("[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/)", user, "/", repo, "/main/Capture.PNG")
  demo_url <- paste0("https://", user, ".github.io/", repo, "/")
  code_url <- paste0("[https://github.com/](https://github.com/)", user, "/", repo)
  
  clean_name <- toupper(gsub("-animint|-test", "", repo))

  # We use pure HTML tags here to bypass Markdown processing
  row <- paste0(
    "<tr>",
    "<td><img src='", img_url, "' width='200'></td>",
    "<td><b>", clean_name, "</b></td>",
    "<td><a href='", demo_url, "'>Demo</a><br><a href='", code_url, "'>Source</a></td>",
    "</tr>"
  )
  cat(row, "\n")
}

cat("</tbody>\n</table>")
